model: Chip-EV push/fold Nash by fictitious play. Folded to the pusher; players behind call or fold in turn, first call ends the action. Equal effective stacks. Blinds 0.5/1 BB; ante per player in BB.
threshold_rule: act when effective stack <= threshold (BB); 0 = never; max = at every grid stack
grid_layout: 13x13, ranks AKQJT98765432; diagonal pairs, upper suited, lower offsuit
